files.content:
1: package llmverify
2: 
3: import chisel3._
4: import chisel3.util._
5: 
6: class sampleq(WIDTH: Int = 2, LENGTH: Int = 4, LOGLENGTH: Int = 2) extends Module {
7:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
8:     val inaddr = Input(UInt(WIDTH.W))
9:     val validin = Input(Bool())
10:     val readin = Input(Bool())
11:     val clkin = Input(Clock())
12:     val bus_gnt = Input(Bool())
13:     val bus_req = Output(Bool())
14:     val outaddr = Output(UInt(WIDTH.W))
15:     val validout = Output(Bool())
16:     val outisaread = Output(Bool())
17:     val readheadentry = Output(UInt(WIDTH.W))
18:     val match_out = Output(Bool())
19:     val storeaddr = Output(UInt(LOGLENGTH.W))
20:     val readhead = Output(UInt(LOGLENGTH.W))
21:   })
22:   
23:   // FIFO memories
24:   val readfifo = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(LENGTH)(0.U(WIDTH.W))))
25:   val writefifo = RegInit(VecInit(Seq.fill(LENGTH)(0.U(WIDTH.W))))
26:   
27:   // Pointers
28:   val readtail = RegInit(0.U(LOGLENGTH.W))
29:   val readheadReg = RegInit(0.U(LOGLENGTH.W))
30:   val writehead = RegInit(0.U(LOGLENGTH.W))
31:   val writetail = RegInit(0.U(LOGLENGTH.W))
32:   
33:   // Control signals
34:   val matchReg = RegInit(false.B)
35:   val outaddrReg = RegInit(0.U(WIDTH.W))
36:   val outisareadReg = RegInit(false.B)
37:   val validoutReg = RegInit(false.B)
38:   val storeaddrReg = RegInit(0.U(LOGLENGTH.W))
39:   
40:   // FIFO status
41:   val readempty = (readtail === readheadReg)
42:   val writeempty = (writetail === writehead)
43:   val readfull = ((readtail + 1.U) & ((1.U << LOGLENGTH) - 1.U)) === readheadReg
44:   val writefull = ((writetail + 1.U) & ((1.U << LOGLENGTH) - 1.U)) === writehead
45:   
46:   // Read head entry
47:   val readheadentryWire = readfifo(readheadReg)
48:   
49:   // Input processing
50:   when(io.validin && io.readin && !readfull) {
51:     readfifo(readtail) := io.inaddr
52:     readtail := readtail + 1.U
53:   }.elsewhen(io.validin && !io.readin && !writefull) {
54:     writefifo(writetail) := io.inaddr
55:     writetail := writetail + 1.U
56:   }
57:   
58:   // Bus grant processing
59:   when(io.bus_gnt) {
60:     // Check for match between read queue entry and write queue entries
61:     matchReg := false.B
62:     storeaddrReg := readheadReg
63:     
64:     for (i <- 0 until LENGTH) {
65:       val writeEntryValid = Mux(
66:         writehead < writetail,
67:         (i.U >= writehead) && (i.U < writetail),
68:         (i.U >= writehead) || (i.U < writetail)
69:       )
70:       
71:       when(writeEntryValid && !readempty && (readfifo(readheadReg) === writefifo(i.U))) {
72:         matchReg := true.B
73:         storeaddrReg := readheadReg
74:       }
75:     }
76:     
77:     // Output selection
78:     when(!readempty && !matchReg) {
79:       outaddrReg := readfifo(readheadReg)
80:       readheadReg := readheadReg + 1.U
81:       outisareadReg := true.B
82:       validoutReg := true.B
83:     }.elsewhen(!writeempty) {
84:       outaddrReg := writefifo(writehead)
85:       writehead := writehead + 1.U
86:       outisareadReg := false.B
87:       validoutReg := true.B
88:     }.otherwise {
89:       validoutReg := false.B
90:     }
91:   }
92:   
93:   // Outputs
94:   io.bus_req := !(readempty && writeempty)
95:   io.outaddr := outaddrReg
96:   io.validout := validoutReg
97:   io.outisaread := outisareadReg
98:   io.readheadentry := readheadentryWire
99:   io.match_out := matchReg
100:   io.storeaddr := storeaddrReg
101:   io.readhead := readheadReg
102: }
103: 
104: class Buechi extends Module {
105:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
106:     val clock = Input(Clock())
107:     val q0match = Input(Bool())
108:     val q0storeaddrNEQq0readhead = Input(Bool())
109:     val busgnt0 = Input(Bool())
110:     val fair = Output(Bool())
111:     val scc = Output(Bool())
112:   })
113:   
114:   // State enumeration
115:   val s_n1 :: s_n2 :: s_n3 :: s_n4 :: s_Trap :: Nil = Enum(5)
116:   val state = RegInit(s_n2)
117:   
118:   // Nondeterministic transitions (simplified to deterministic for Chisel)
119:   val ND_n3_n4 = Mux(state === s_n3, s_n4, s_n3) // Simplified choice
120:   val ND_n1_n2 = Mux(state === s_n1, s_n2, s_n1) // Simplified choice
121:   
122:   // Output assignments
123:   io.fair := (state === s_n4)
124:   io.scc := (state === s_n3) || (state === s_n4)
125:   
126:   // State transition logic
127:   when(state === s_n3 || state === s_n4) {
128:     val inputs = Cat(io.busgnt0, io.q0storeaddrNEQq0readhead)
129:     switch(inputs) {
130:       is("b00".U) { state := s_n3 }
131:       is("b01".U) { state := s_Trap }
132:       is("b11".U) { state := s_Trap }
133:       is("b10".U) { state := ND_n3_n4 }
134:     }
135:   }.elsewhen(state === s_n2) {
136:     val inputs = Cat(io.q0match, io.q0storeaddrNEQq0readhead)
137:     switch(inputs) {
138:       is("b00".U) { state := s_n2 }
139:       is("b01".U) { state := s_n2 }
140:       is("b10".U) { state := ND_n1_n2 }
141:       is("b11".U) { state := s_n2 }
142:     }
143:   }.elsewhen(state === s_Trap) {
144:     state := s_Trap
145:   }.elsewhen(state === s_n1) {
146:     when(io.q0storeaddrNEQq0readhead === false.B) {
147:       state := s_n3
148:     }.otherwise {
149:       state := s_Trap
150:     }
151:   }
152: }

154: class twoQ(WIDTH: Int = 2) extends Module {
155:   val io = IO(new Bundle {
156:     val clock = Input(Clock())
157:     val inaddr0 = Input(UInt(WIDTH.W))
158:     val inaddr1 = Input(UInt(WIDTH.W))
159:     val validin = Input(UInt(2.W))
160:     val readin = Input(UInt(2.W))
161:     val select = Input(Bool())
162:     
163:     // Additional outputs to preserve design
164:     val bus_req = Output(UInt(2.W))
165:     val validout = Output(UInt(2.W))
166:     val outisread = Output(UInt(2.W))
167:     val outaddr0 = Output(UInt(WIDTH.W))
168:     val outaddr1 = Output(UInt(WIDTH.W))
169:     val readheadentry0 = Output(UInt(WIDTH.W))
170:     val readheadentry1 = Output(UInt(WIDTH.W))
171:     val fair = Output(Bool())
172:     val scc = Output(Bool())
173:     val q0match = Output(Bool())
174:     val q1match = Output(Bool())
175:     val q0storeaddr = Output(UInt(2.W))
176:     val q1storeaddr = Output(UInt(2.W))
177:     val q0readhead = Output(UInt(2.W))
178:     val q1readhead = Output(UInt(2.W))
179:   })
180:   
181:   // Instantiate sampleq modules
182:   val q0 = Module(new sampleq(WIDTH))
183:   val q1 = Module(new sampleq(WIDTH))
184:   
185:   // Connect q0
186:   q0.io.inaddr := io.inaddr0
187:   q0.io.validin := io.validin(0)
188:   q0.io.readin := io.readin(0)
189:   q0.io.clkin := io.clock
190:   
191:   // Connect q1
192:   q1.io.inaddr := io.inaddr1
193:   q1.io.validin := io.validin(1)
194:   q1.io.readin := io.readin(1)
195:   q1.io.clkin := io.clock
196:   
197:   // Bus grant register
198:   val bus_gnt = RegInit(0.U(2.W))
199:   
200:   // Bus request signals
201:   val bus_req = Wire(UInt(2.W))
202:   bus_req := Cat(q1.io.bus_req, q0.io.bus_req)
203:   
204:   // Connect bus grants to sampleq modules
205:   q0.io.bus_gnt := bus_gnt(0)
206:   q1.io.bus_gnt := bus_gnt(1)
207:   
208:   // Bus grant arbitration logic
209:   when(io.select && bus_req(1)) {
210:     bus_gnt := 2.U(2.W)
211:   }.elsewhen(!io.select && bus_req(0)) {
212:     bus_gnt := 1.U(2.W)
213:   }.otherwise {
214:     bus_gnt := 0.U(2.W)
215:   }
216:   
217:   // Buechi module signals
218:   val q0storeaddrNEQq0readhead = (q0.io.storeaddr === q0.io.readhead)
219:   val busgnt0 = (bus_gnt(0) === 1.U)
220:   
221:   // Instantiate Buechi module
222:   val buechi = Module(new Buechi())
223:   buechi.io.clock := io.clock
224:   buechi.io.q0match := q0.io.match_out
225:   buechi.io.q0storeaddrNEQq0readhead := q0storeaddrNEQq0readhead
226:   buechi.io.busgnt0 := busgnt0
227:   
228:   // Connect outputs
229:   io.bus_req := bus_req
230:   io.validout := Cat(q1.io.validout, q0.io.validout)
231:   io.outisread := Cat(q1.io.outisaread, q0.io.outisaread)
232:   io.outaddr0 := q0.io.outaddr
233:   io.outaddr1 := q1.io.outaddr
234:   io.readheadentry0 := q0.io.readheadentry
235:   io.readheadentry1 := q1.io.readheadentry
236:   io.fair := buechi.io.fair
237:   io.scc := buechi.io.scc
238:   io.q0match := q0.io.match_out
239:   io.q1match := q1.io.match_out
240:   io.q0storeaddr := q0.io.storeaddr
241:   io.q1storeaddr := q1.io.storeaddr
242:   io.q0readhead := q0.io.readhead
243:   io.q1readhead := q1.io.readhead
244: }
245: 
246: object VerilogGenerator extends App {
247:   emitVerilog(new twoQ(), args)
248: }
